source_identity.role: existing immutable extraction reference, not an adopted or fully qualified ADC
source_identity.bootstrap: Canvas-derived physical common-G topology; two parallel 1um/150nm main units per side
source_identity.comparator: N4 native-NMOS candidate with ordinary-IO tail/reset/latch and rx2 receiving inverter
source_identity.historical_performance_owner: 027b951 idle-reset candidate; its full-code/FFT results are not inherited

block_hash_definition: SHA256 of UTF-8 subckt-through-ends text after universal-newline normalization; exclude trailing newline after ends
dependency_rule: Recursively retain every child subckt of each extraction root from the same candidate DUT. PDK model bodies are external read-only dependencies, not copied. Future managed preparation must verify actual model include hashes.

boundaries.sample_clock: SAMPLE -> XSAMPLE -> SAMPLE_INT -> XIDLE.SAMPLE_MATCH -> XSEQ -> SEQ_SAMPLE -> both Bootstrap CLKS; keep physical stages and their loads
boundaries.sampling_input: VINP_SRC/VINN_SRC -> existing 50ohm each -> VINP/VINN -> Bootstrap Vin
boundaries.sampled_output: Bootstrap VOUT -> TOPP/TOPN -> all CDAC MOM units/dummies and actual N4 comparator input devices; no ideal input capacitance substitution
boundaries.reference: Retain actual CDAC pass devices, XREF drivers/state cells and per-rail 50ohm/4pF networks. A fixed-state run still uses physical drivers. Reference switching correctness belongs to the reference audit.
boundaries.comparator_reset: Hold existing N4 CLK low during isolated sampling/droop so real reset devices and input coupling remain. Preserve CL_COMP_N/P and rx2 COMP_P/N receiver loading; downstream receiver loads must be mapped before fixture approval, never clamp COMP outputs.
boundaries.cut_input_policy: Use recorded/independently checked boundary logic for reproduction, then defined fixed states for isolation. No ideal source drives G, BTOP, BBOT or a CDAC top/bottom. A forced boundary is a diagnostic testbench input and does not qualify the omitted controller.
load_mapping_pending: fanout loads on SAMPLE_INT/PRESET/SEQ_SAMPLE after controller cut
receiver PR/NR downstream fanout and feedback dependency

fixed_contract.power_ramp_range_role: pending experimental parameters; not approved product startup specification

time_contract.source_waveform_reference: candidate_testbench VSAMPLE: val0=SUP val1=0 delay=41n rise=100p fall=100p width=59.9n period=100n
time_contract.steady_source_rule: For t>=101ns use exactly the original voltage-versus-absolute-time SAMPLE schedule. The existing transition starts rising at 101ns and starts falling at 141ns. Retain 100ps edges; nominal half-level crossings are 101.05/141.05ns. Do not shift waveforms by the plot origin.
time_contract.actual_open: positive 0.5*VDD crossing of SEQ_SAMPLE, after physical clock-chain delays
time_contract.nominal_interface_edge: separately record SAMPLE and SAMPLE_INT negative 0.5*VDD crossings; neither is asserted to equal physical aperture
time_contract.hold_read_rule: historical diagnostic t_h=100*k+41.8ns, only valid if actual_close<t_h<first_comparison and reference states have not changed; otherwise mark invalid, never move t_h to manufacture a pass
time_contract.legacy_high_DC_frame: frame0 has no observed opening event: duration=null, startup=true, excluded_from_normal_acquisition_pass=true; retain its voltages/errors and failed code
time_contract.source_corner_coupling: same external absolute schedule across variants; compare actual opening/closing times and report load-induced movement before acceptance

fixtures.prehistory: original DC VDD/reference/input and SAMPLE high at simulation start; no preceding forced low phase
controlled_variables: original source waveforms and candidate devices
fixtures.comparison: retain frame0 at 41.8ns and frame1 at 141.8ns separately; no physical opening event in frame0

fixtures.role: test whether explicit physical precharge removes initial-history sensitivity
fixtures.prehistory: SAMPLE low before the existing rise at 101ns; supply/reference/input initially retain the original DC conditions. Vary only how long the low prehistory is supplied in a separately declared preparation interval.
controlled_variables: low-phase prehistory duration only, once an executable absolute-time prelude is approved
fixtures.comparison: first full acquisition ends at the existing 141ns source falling transition; normal measurements use frame1 and the same source inputs as the control
fixtures.acceptance: demonstrate naturally established Cboot voltage and reproducible first full acquisition; required precharge and startup budgets remain null

fixtures.role: candidate experiment specification, not an approved power-on contract
fixtures.prehistory: use the low-phase clock prelude; replace only VDD DC by a declared 0-to-final-supply ramp, completed before the common 101ns steady schedule. Hold reference/input startup order fixed and record any input-above-supply exposure.
controlled_variables: VDD ramp duration in the first experiment
startup clock phase in a separate later experiment
fixtures.prerequisite: parent reviews ramp range, rail sequencing and executable prelude before a recipe exists

fixtures.role: normal operation after observed natural precharge; independent of startup acceptance
fixtures.prehistory: record one or more complete physical low/high cycles and Cboot recovery before selecting normal cycles; report the selected cycle indices
fixtures.load_state: complete CDAC and actual comparator reset input load; fixed physical reference state first, then separately replay checked neighboring switching

preclose_error.report_also: TOPP-VINP_SRC, TOPN-VINN_SRC, x_source-x_pin and G-Vin each side
preclose_error.dynamic_role: tracking diagnostic, not a substitute for final sampled transfer

held_error.at: valid t_h as defined by time_contract
held_error.dynamic_formula: y(t_h)-x_source(nominal interface sampling edge); retain the exact chosen edge identifier
held_error.first_frame_policy: startup error reported even without opening; no normal window or pass assigned

net_turnoff_change.condition: static source unchanged over interval; retain reference and clock traces
net_turnoff_change.interpretation: includes continued settling, feedthrough, channel charge and coupled reference response; not isolated charge injection

hold_droop.interval: t_h to declared hold deadline, before any intended DAC update or comparator evaluation
hold_droop.conditions: comparator reset and reference command states fixed; actual reference motion monitored; test input held and toggled in separate controls
hold_droop.report_also: single-ended top changes and common-mode motion

dynamic_gain_phase.observations: one analog held value per accepted normal cycle, assigned to the unchanged nominal interface edge
dynamic_gain_phase.method: known-frequency DC+sin+cos fit to analog held values; report source amplitude/phase, fitted DC/gain/phase and raw edge-referenced error

nonfundamental_residual.formula: held samples minus their fitted DC and fundamental
nonfundamental_residual.interpretation: diagnostic distortion/history/numerical residual; not transient noise or static INL

common_delay_check.method: choose one delay using the preregistered low-frequency condition, apply unchanged to other frequencies; retain DC/gain and compare held values to delayed source

device_stress.method: all MOS six terminal-pair extrema at native time points plus native CMI and convergence messages

diagnostic_sequence: Verify source hashes, recursive dependency/port map and cut-port fanout before an executable fixture is prepared.
Reproduce SS-hot high-DC startup and its input-polarity control without sizing changes.
Compare explicit natural low-phase precharge at the same normal-cycle absolute schedule; inspect all Bootstrap internal nodes and branch currents.
Review ramp parameters and then assess startup separately; no startup pass until its contract is approved.
Reproduce SS-cold normal bidirectional steps and TT control with complete load; measure preclose, turnoff change and droop separately.
Only after reproduction, examine dynamic transfer and checked reference-coupling controls; parent allocates any missing limits.
No further W sweep until a residual normal-cycle current/charge or edge-load bottleneck is demonstrated.
